name: arcane eye
lore:
### Arcane Eye: The Unblinking Sentinel

To cast *Arcane Eye* is to stretch one’s consciousness across the invisible sinews of the Weave. As the incantation peaks, the practitioner feels a distinct, cooling pressure behind the brow—a phantom optic nerve reaching out into the ether. It is a sensation of profound displacement, as if your very soul has grown a long, silver tether.

The manifestation is a fist-sized orb of shimmering, translucent light, resembling a crystalline iris suspended in a nebula of indigo smoke. It moves with a ghostly fluidness, weightless and silent, transmitting visions directly into the mind's eye. To the mundane, it is naught but a ripple in the air; to the mage, it is a window into the hidden.

**The Legend of Discovery**
Scholars credit this sorcery to the paranoid Archmage Vaelen the Vigilant. It is whispered that Vaelen, besieged by unseen assassins, sacrificed his own reflection in a pool of enchanted quicksilver to birth the first Eye. He spent his final decades locked in a windowless tower, yet it was said he saw every leaf fall in the kingdom below. Use this tool wisely, traveler; to see all is to invite the burden of knowing all.
